about_the_game:
Unearthed Spoils Anthology Two


Enjoy Unearthed Spoils volumes #006 - #010 compiled into one massive module with additional content!




Unearthed Spoils Anthology Two contains the following content:



    TWELVE CLASS ARCHETYPES - Including the Circle of the Sanguine Bloom Druid, Way of Hemokenesis Monk, and Elder Vampyre Warlock
  • SIX CHARACTER BACKGROUNDS - Delve into rich character origins like the Dragon Hunter, Planar Born, and Revenant's Bond
  • THIRTY-ONE MAGICAL SPELLS - Unearth devastating new magic with themed spell lists such as Colossal Cantrips and Desecrated Magic
  • SEVENTY MAGIC ITEMS - Empower your adventurers with powerful new gear, including massive weapons, draconic artifacts, and cursed relics
  • SIXTY-THREE MONSTERS & NPCS - Challenge your players with undead horrors, planar foes, titanic beasts, and more
  • FIVE ADVENTURES FOR MID-LEVEL PLAY - Explore full-length quests like A Titan's Awakening and Exsanguinated, complete with printable maps and unique encounters
Bring undead, giants, blood magic, dimensional chaos, and dragons into your D&D 5e campaigns--all in one beautiful module.


"
